Attaching my quick debrief from the Anita call. Short summary below; full notes in doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xRefNotesExampleID

- Overall impression: Strong collaborator, pragmatic problem-solver.
- Ownership: Led rollout of payment retry service; owned incident response for ~48h during spike, coordinated across infra and product.
- Technical depth: Solid system design; comfortable with tradeoffs for latency vs cost.
- Communication: Clear, good at distilling technical details for PMs.
- Areas to probe: depth on async data pipelines (Samir may have stronger examples).

Recommendation: Move forward to final onsite loop; flag a deeper backend/data design problem in the loop for validation.

Next steps: Evelyn to paste Samir notes into same doc; I'll merge and add a short hiring-team recommendation.

Marcus Lin
Senior Eng Manager, Platform
